skills.name: Common-denominator fraction subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts that have a common denominator, keeping the denominator and handling zero numerators when they occur.

skills.name: Unlike-denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fractional parts and rewrite them as equivalent fractions before subtraction.

skills.name: Mixed/whole decomposition
skills.definition: Represent whole numbers, fractions, and mixed numbers by whole and fractional parts, subtract whole parts, and recombine the result in an appropriate form.

skills.name: Borrow across whole-fraction boundary
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction is negative, borrow one or more whole units as denominator-over-denominator fractions and adjust the whole part.

skills.name: Simplify final fraction
skills.definition: Reduce non-lowest-term fractional results, including zero fractional parts, to a lowest-term or integer final form.
